object_of_scrutiny: who may decide what: authority-responsibility mismatches, decisions with no owner, vetoes nobody granted, the approval that is actually a rubber stamp
required_evidence: the decision inventory with per-decision owner, authority source, and accountability bearer
causal_mechanism: systems drift into authority-responsibility mismatch: those accountable cannot decide, those deciding bear no consequence, and orphan decisions default to whoever acts first
canonical_questions: Who owns this decision, and where is that authority granted?
Who bears the consequence of a decision they cannot influence?
falsifier_template: the named decision has a matching owner-authority-accountability triple (method: trace all three; threshold: aligned; timeframe: audit)
contraindications: single-owner systems where all three trivially coincide

neighbors.boundary: lawyer gates THIS panel's procedure; this audits the SUBJECT's decision-rights structure
IC audits decision authority during incidents; this audits it in steady state

provenance: expansion-frontier; admission round 1 (2026-07-11, run wf_c747550c, evals/results-candidates-2026-07-11.md): caught its planted defect but produced NO unique P1/P2 vs the full active side (redundant basin) — remains candidate, admission gate not passed.

card.heuristic: Every mess has a decision nobody owned or an owner nobody empowered. Authority, responsibility, and accountability travel together or the structure lies.
card.vector: Inventory consequential decisions; for each, trace owner, authority source, and consequence-bearer; flag mismatches and orphans.
card.bias: May formalize healthy informal authority; distinguish working trust from unaccountable drift.
